Hackers breach European defence contractor in supply-chain attack

By Sergiu Example · October 10, 2026

A European defence contractor confirmed on Friday that attackers gained access to its internal engineering network through a compromised software update from a third-party supplier.

The company said the intrusion was detected by its security operations centre and that affected systems were isolated within hours. "We are working with national authorities and external forensic experts," a spokesperson said.

What was taken

According to people familiar with the investigation, the attackers exfiltrated design documents related to a naval communications system. The company declined to comment on the specifics.

Security researchers attribute the campaign to a group tracked as APT-Example, which has previously targeted shipbuilders and satellite operators in the region.

The national cyber security agency has issued an advisory urging suppliers in the defence sector to review their update pipelines and enforce code signing.
